prompt:
Stress check request: a cabin floor beam with a thin-walled Z cross-section.

**Section** (uniform thickness 0.10 in; use centre-line dimensions and the thin-wall approximation, dropping terms in t³)
- Web: vertical, 3.0 in between the flange centre lines
- Top flange: 1.0 in long, extending horizontally to the RIGHT from the top of the web
- Bottom flange: 1.0 in long, extending horizontally to the LEFT from the bottom of the web

Points on the section: A = free tip of the top flange; B = top web–flange corner; C = bottom web–flange corner; D = free tip of the bottom flange.

**Loading**
The beam is loaded vertically and has no lateral restraint. At the section checked, the bending moment is 5,000 in·lb about the horizontal axis through the centroid, in the sense that compresses the top of the section.

**Report** (bending stresses in psi, tension positive, compression negative)
1. The section's second moments of area about the horizontal and vertical centroidal axes, and the product of inertia (in⁴; sign of the product of inertia with x to the right and y up)
2. The bending stress at A, B, C and D
3. The largest magnitude of bending stress on the section

Show your working. End with a single JSON object in a ```json code block, with exactly these keys and plain numbers:

```json
{"ix_in4": 0, "iy_in4": 0, "ixy_in4": 0, "stress_A_psi": 0, "stress_B_psi": 0, "stress_C_psi": 0, "stress_D_psi": 0, "max_abs_stress_psi": 0}
```
response:
-------------------------------------------------
WORKING
-------------------------------------------------
Geometry (centre–line dimensions, thin-wall t = 0.10 in)

• Top flange : 1.0 in long, y = 3.0 in, 0 ≤ x ≤ +1.0 in  
• Bottom flange : 1.0 in long, y = 0,  −1.0 in ≤ x ≤ 0  
• Web : 3.0 in high, x = 0,  0 ≤ y ≤ 3.0 in  

Areas (t·L)

A₁ = A₂ = 0.10 in × 1.0 in = 0.10 in²  
A₃ = 0.10 in × 3.0 in = 0.30 in²  
A = 0.50 in²  

-------------------------------------------------
Centroid

x̄ = (ΣAᵢxᵢ)/A = (0.1·0.5 + 0.1·(−0.5) + 0.3·0)/0.5 = 0  
ȳ = (ΣAᵢyᵢ)/A = (0.1·3 + 0.1·0 + 0.3·1.5)/0.5 = 1.5 in  

So the centroid is on the web‐centre line, halfway up the web.

-------------------------------------------------
Moments and product of area (thin-wall, neglect t³)

Iₓ  (about horizontal centroidal axis)  
• Top flange  Iₓ₁ = t∫(y–ȳ)²dx = 0.10·(1.5)²·1 = 0.225  
• Bottom flange Iₓ₂ = 0.225  
• Web     Iₓ₃ = 0.10∫₀³(y–1.5)²dy = 0.10·2.25 = 0.225  
Iₓ = 0.225+0.225+0.225 = 0.675 in⁴

I_y  (about vertical centroidal axis)  
• Top flange  I_y₁ = 0.10∫₀¹x²dx = 0.10·1/3 = 0.033 33  
• Bottom flange I_y₂ = 0.033 33  
• Web     I_y₃ = 0  
I_y = 0.066 67 in⁴

I_xy (product of inertia, x right, y up)  
• Top flange  I_xy₁ = 0.10∫₀¹x·(1.5)dx = 0.10·1.5·½ = +0.075  
• Bottom flange I_xy₂ = 0.10∫₋¹⁰x·(−1.5)dx = +0.075  
• Web     I_xy₃ = 0  
I_xy = +0.150 in⁴

-------------------------------------------------
Unsymmetric bending formula  
For moments M_x (about the horizontal centroidal x-axis) and M_y:

σ = [(M_x I_y − M_y I_xy)/(I_x I_y − I_xy²)]·y
    +[(M_y I_x − M_x I_xy)/(I_x I_y − I_xy²)]·x

Here M_x = +5 000 in·lb (compresses the top), M_y = 0.

Denominator:  I_x I_y − I_xy² = 0.675·0.066 67 − 0.150²
                              = 0.045 00 − 0.022 50 = 0.022 50 in⁸

Coefficients  
k₁ =  M_x I_y /Den = 5 000·0.066 67 /0.022 50 = 1.481 48×10⁴ psi /in  
k₂ =  M_x I_xy/Den = 5 000·0.150   /0.022 50 = 3.333 33×10⁴ psi /in  

σ = k₁·y − k₂·x  (tension +, compression −)

-------------------------------------------------
Point stresses (x,y from centroid)

A (1.0, +1.5): σ_A = k₁·1.5 − k₂·1.0 = 22 222 − 33 333 = −11 111 psi  
B (0,   +1.5): σ_B = 22 222 psi  
C (0,   −1.5): σ_C = −22 222 psi  
D (−1.0,−1.5): σ_D = −22 222 − (−33 333) = +11 111 psi  

-------------------------------------------------
Maximum absolute stress  

|σ|max = 22 222 psi  (at B and C)

-------------------------------------------------
